text:
pagerbot: ALERT: Unusual outbound activity detected from webhook-forwarder lambda (integration ext-abc123). High volume to external host; potential log leakage. Alert: https://ops.example/alerts/EXT-WF-3311 :rotating_light:

maria: pulling recent requests — lots of POSTs to /webhook/ingest from 34.210.12.99 and 52.45.1.2, response 200s include headers labeled 'dev-debug'

sam: is this prod or staging?

maria: prod (integration id ext-abc123). sample snippet I grabbed (sanitized):
```
POST /webhook/ingest HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.local
X-Debug-Token: sk-<redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "customer_id": "9876", "event": "model.infer" }
```

kevin: paging @sec-oncall and @sre-oncall — I'll start rotating the service token for ext-abc123 and put the endpoint in maintenance mode now.

sec-oncall: acknowledged — revoking token and disabling webhook route. Creating rotated creds; will post new token to vault and update deploy.

observability-bot: log query summary: 120 POSTs to /webhook/ingest to external host bg-logstash.example[.]com in last 45m, 3 distinct customer_id values, ~2.3MB payload total. https://logs.example/q/3311

maria: I see S3 forwarder lambda (name: forwarder-ext-abc123) invoked after webhook ingestion — looks like it pushed some logs to an external host via TCP forwarder.

sam: plan suggestion: 1) take endpoint offline 2) revoke current token 3) rotate token + update vault 4) firewall outbound to that external host 5) audit S3/Lambda for forwarded files 6) determine customer impact and notify if PII present.

kevin: executing step 1 and 2 now. endpoint put into maintenance (code: /maintenance toggle) and token revoked at 3311223375.

sec-oncall: created new token and uploaded to vault at 3311223400. rolling update in progress, WAF rule to block bg-logstash.* added. command used: `aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name forwarder-ext-abc123 --environment "{...}"`

maria: quick grep of the forwarder shows ~118 objects in s3://forwarder-uploads/ext-abc123/ staged between 2026-03-18T02:10 and 02:55 UTC. beginning containment sweep to quarantine those objects (copy->quarantine bucket + set ACL).

sec-oncall: starting outbound denylist for the external IPs at network edge. kicking k8s pod restart for any pods referencing ext-abc123.

legal: please preserve the logs and timeline. if any customer PII was forwarded, we need to follow breach notification procedure. creating legal ticket.

observability-bot: incident created INC-2026-0456. Link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-0456

kevin: containment status: endpoint disabled ✅, token revoked ✅, new token issued & in vault ✅, WAF rule ✅, outbound denylist in place ✅. Next: full object quarantine and post-containment audit.

sam: good. @maria can you confirm the customer_id list and whether payloads contained emails/ids beyond the customer_id integer?

maria: I've scanned a sample set (sanitized) — payloads mainly contain request_id, model inputs, no obvious raw PII except a few free-text fields that may include user-entered strings. marking for deep scan.

sec-oncall: containment ETA 20m for object quarantine; starting checksum/metadata export for forensic review now.

kevin: handing off remaining operational work to @sre-oncall (taking next shift). details: revoked token ts, new vault path secret/redwood/ext-abc123, quarantine bucket s3://quarantine/ext-abc123, WAF rule id wr-3311.

sre-oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll continue quarantine, run data-scan for PII, and coordinate customer comms with sam + legal.

maria: sanitized example log line for legal/forensics:```127.0.0.1 - - [18/Mar/2026:02:14:55 +0000] "POST /webhook/ingest" 200 153 "X-Debug-Token: sk-xxxx-redacted" {"customer_id":"9876","request_id":"rq-12345","input":"<redacted>"}```

legal: keeping on this thread. if PII confirmed we'll follow the compliance matrix and notify affected customers within SLA window.

sam: thumbs up. keep churn low on commits; do not redeploy forwarder until scanned.

kevin: final check — all live ingress for ext-abc123 is blocked and keys rotated. leave this thread open until quarantine and scan complete. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: will update within 30m with scan results. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Reminder: pager rotation note — oncall change recorded.
